View.name: ArchiMate 3 Implementation and Migration::Implementation and Migration

Stereotype.name: Business
Stereotype.notes: The Business Layer offers products and services to external customers, which are realized in the organization by business processes performed by business actors.

Stereotype.name: Application
Stereotype.notes: The Application Layer supports the business layer with application services which are realized by (software) applications.

Stereotype.name: Technology
Stereotype.notes: The Technology Layer offers infrastructure services (e.g., processing, storage, and communication services) needed to run applications, realized by computer and communication hardware and system software.

Stereotype.name: Motivation
Stereotype.notes: The Motivation extension of ArchiMate adds the motivational concepts such as goal, principle, and requirement.

Stereotype.name: Implementation
Stereotype.notes: The Implementation and Migration extension of ArchiMate adds concepts to support the late ADM phases, related to the implementation and migration of architectures.
